## Stock Performance Data

### O'Reilly Automotive, Inc.

## Five Year Change in Value

The five year change in value of O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. stock from December 31, 2013 to December 31, 2018 is calculated as follows:

- Initial value (2013): $92
- Final value (2018): $247
- Change in value: $247 - $92 = $155
